title: saved card
description:
## saved card
Returning customers enter full card details on every order; checkout for returning customers averages 2m40s, and no payment data is stored today. The Q4 growth goal is +15% conversion for returning customers. Payment-data entry is the 3rd-highest drop-off point in funnel analytics. Keep it to web checkout and cards via the current PSP, not native apps, wallets, or bank transfers.
When a returning customer with saved payment details reaches checkout, make the saved method available for selection without re-entering card details. If a customer opts to save payment details and payment completes, store the details for future checkouts. When a saved method is used at checkout and payment completes, the customer reaches the confirmation page.
epic_context: Payment Platform Expansion — Alternative Payment Methods
roadmap_context: Grow revenue and conversion by expanding the checkout to modern payment methods and making payment flows reliable. Roadmap context: Q3-Q4 growth initiative; business goal is +8% checkout conversion and reduced payment-failure support tickets. Success is measured via checkout funnel analytics and the payments incident rate.
